theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $x$ be a length-$n$ integer input stored before a free pointer. Suppose a concrete color program and entry procedure satisfy the stated color law with resource function and per-color time, and the complete driver resource predicate holds. The assembled fast driver, entered at procedure $|P_{\mathrm{color}}|+26$, returns a Boolean equivalent to the existence of three distinct indices with zero sum, preserves earlier memory, and meets its exact finite-color time bound.

This driver theorem promotes a concrete per-color execution law to an exact original-input 3SUM decision.
